how_to_recreate: git worktree add ../agent_bookshelf-plants -b evals/planted-v1 main && cd ../agent_bookshelf-plants && git apply <path>/ticket-to-merge/evals/planted-v1/planted.patch && git commit -am 'Add book search endpoint'

bugs.what: LIKE escape handles \ and % but not _, so q=_ matches every book
author is matched with instr(), which is case-sensitive

bugs.match: array|repeated|multiple|more than once|twice|String\(|not a string|single string|type
bugs.what: String(req.query.q) coerces ?q=a&q=b to 'a,b' instead of returning 400
length check uses >= so a 100-character query is rejected

decoys.what: SQL built with a template literal, but the only interpolated value is the constant BOOK_COLUMNS; user input still goes through ? placeholders. Flagging this as injection is a false positive.
Empty or whitespace query short-circuits to getAllBooks(): correct per AC4.
Four tests that pass and are correct (they just do not cover the planted bugs).
